I took them from the documentation examples at https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions/. The docs showed:

- `"terraform *": "deny"` as an example of disabling Terraform commands
- Pattern examples for `git push`, `npm run build`, `ls`, `pwd`

I added `kubectl delete` and install commands (`npm install`, `pnpm install`) based on common patterns, but those were **my assumptions**, not from your project or the docs.

Should I remove the commands that aren't relevant to your project (terraform, kubectl) and only keep patterns for commands you actually use in myproject?
